name: legal-skills
description: Governed legal workflows, mostly Australian: research, contracts, drafting, employment, privacy, consumer and competition, corporations, AI governance, AML/CTF, estates, litigation deadlines, evidence, matter triage and jurisdiction-neutral reasoning practice, with official-source verification and qualified-lawyer review gates.

interface.shortDescription: Governed Australian legal workflows with official-source verification and lawyer review gates.
interface.longDescription: One plugin for Australian legal research, contract review and drafting, employment, privacy, consumer and competition, corporations, AI governance, AML/CTF, estate planning, litigation deadlines, evidence handling and matter triage, plus jurisdiction-neutral sparring that pressure-tests a lawyer's own reasoning. Every research workflow verifies against official sources at use, labels pending law separately from current law, fails closed on missing inputs and returns drafts for qualified human review.
defaultPrompt: Route this matter to the skills it engages and tell me what to run first.
Verify this Commonwealth provision as in force on a given date.
Review this MSA against our contract-review playbook and return an issues table.
Assess whether this incident is an eligible data breach under the Privacy Act.
Compute the procedural deadlines that run from this filing.
Map our AI governance obligations, separating binding from pending instruments.
